help.stdout:
usage: gnd import ilp-rules [-h] --labels LABELS --reported-coverage
                            REPORTED_COVERAGE --target
                            {popper,neutral,ilasp,llm,rules} --out OUT
                            [--actor ACTOR] [--requested-at REQUESTED_AT]
                            [--format {text,json}]
                            model clauses

Rewrite each learned clause wrong(X) :- B1, ..., Bn in the declared fragment
into one guarded constraint (source induced, status proposed, modality
deontic), re-run the checker over the manifest's populations, and write an
evolve proposal only if, for every clause, the set of example ids GND covers
equals the set the run record reports. Admission is all-or-nothing. Exits 0
when the proposal is written, 3 on any refusal (a construct outside the
fragment, a binding or coverage mismatch, invalid input), 5 when a population
fails to load, 11 when --out exists, 64 on a usage error, 66 on a missing
input, 70 on an internal defect, 74 on a refused path.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file
  clauses               learned clauses: Popper's printed program, an ILASP
                        hypothesis, a printed rule set (rules), or gnd-ilp-
                        clauses/1 JSON

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --labels LABELS       the class-mode label manifest
  --reported-coverage REPORTED_COVERAGE
                        the learner run record (gnd-ilp-run/1)
  --target {popper,neutral,ilasp,llm,rules}
                        the adapter CLAUSES is in
  --out OUT             write the evolve proposal here
  --actor ACTOR         who requests the proposal (its audit actor_id)
  --requested-at REQUESTED_AT
                        the audit time, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (default:
                        now); fix it for reproducible output
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
